title: Complexity coverage classification
responsibility: States whether a file’s decision points can be counted, are absent by file kind, or belong to an unsupported language.

inputs.name: complexityCoverage.path
inputs.description: File path whose lowercased extension determines the supported language or declarative format.

inputs.name: complexityCoverage.scripted
inputs.description: Whether an HTML file contains script; defaults to false and has no effect on other extensions.

inputs.name: uncountedLanguage.path
inputs.description: Path of an unsupported file to label by its lowercased extension.

outputs.name: complexityCoverage
outputs.description: Counted for supported JavaScript, TypeScript and Svelte files; declarative for supported data or presentation formats and scriptless HTML; unsupported otherwise.

outputs.name: uncountedLanguage
outputs.description: Known language name, an extension followed by files, or files without an extension when no extension exists.
